entities.name: José Gómez Mustelier
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Gómez Mustelier a.k.a. Jovani Gomez is a retired Cuban boxer, who won the middleweight gold medal at the 1980 Summer Olympics. In the final he defeated Viktor Savchenko of the USSR on points (4–1). Two years earlier he captured the world title at the second World Championships in Belgrade, followed by the gold medal at the 1979 Pan American Games.
